preferred_translation: recognition of the repulsiveness of food
definition: A specific recognition cultivated for insight and release.
literal_meaning: recognition of the repulsiveness of food
discouraged_translations: perception of the repulsiveness of food
notes: The English follows the sanna record's default: recognition, not perception. Perception is discouraged here because readers take a perception to be a thing in its own right, something held and lasting, whereas sanna is the act of knowing the thing again -- re-cognizing it -- which is what this practice trains.
